title: Solve-Detect-Verify: Inference-Time Scaling with Flexible Generative Verifier
authors_zh: Jianyuan Zhong, Zeju Li, Zhijian Xu, Xiangyu Wen, Kezhi Li, Qiang Xu
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: Solve-Detect-Verify: Inference-Time Scaling with Flexible Generative Verifier records reasoning traces completion probes and verification feedback under fast/slow generative verification.
Solve-Detect-Verify 在快速与慢速生成式验证之间分配预算，并用验证反馈定向修正答案。
why: It makes completion-triggered verification and targeted correction and its audit boundary visible for reasoning-data curation.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate with a concrete feedback/selection object: reasoning traces completion probes and verification feedback.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-form reasoning at test time creates two linked costs: solvers can continue after a usable answer has already appeared, and reliable generative verification can consume thousands of additional tokens. Solve-Detect-Verify (SDV) treats stopping, verification, and revision as one inference trajectory rather than sampling many finished answers and ranking them once.

For atlas purposes, the relevant object is not a released corpus. It is a potential episode record containing the problem, the solver trace, hesitation-triggered completion probes, the stopped prefix, FlexiVe outputs, the first predicted error index (or −1), textual diagnostic feedback, revisions, and the final answer. The paper separately uses BIG-Bench Mistake to train FlexiVe; that training set should not be conflated with SDV rollout records.

长推理在测试时带来两类相互关联的成本：solver 可能在已经形成可用答案后继续生成，而可靠的生成式验证又可能额外消耗数千 token。Solve-Detect-Verify（SDV）把停止、验证与修订视为同一条推理轨迹，而不是先采样大量完整答案再进行一次性排序。

对本图谱而言，相关对象并不是一个已发布语料库，而是一类可记录的 episode：问题、solver 轨迹、由犹豫词触发的完成度探测、提前停止的前缀、FlexiVe 输出、首个预测错误位置（或 −1）、文本诊断反馈、各轮修订及最终答案。论文另用 BIG-Bench Mistake 训练 FlexiVe；该训练集不能与 SDV rollout 记录混为一谈。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
FlexiVe is a holistic generative verifier with three inference modes. Fast Thinking suppresses an explicit rationale and emits a short verification result; Slow Thinking generates a deliberative verification trace; Flex@k first runs k independent fast checks and accepts their majority result when agreement reaches a threshold, otherwise escalating to slow verification. Each verification returns textual analysis F plus the first error index, so the signal can guide correction rather than only rank candidates.

SDV couples this verifier to event-triggered stopping. Hesitation keywords define sparse points at which the solver compares log p(Yes) and log p(No) under a completion prompt; the keyword itself is not treated as proof of completion. A positive log-probability difference stops generation. FlexiVe then accepts the trace or returns feedback for another solve–detect attempt.

FlexiVe 是一个整体式生成验证器，提供三种推理模式。Fast Thinking 不生成显式验证 rationale，只输出简短结论；Slow Thinking 生成审慎的验证轨迹；Flex@k 先并行执行 k 次快速检查，在一致率达到阈值时接受多数结果，否则升级到慢速验证。每次验证都输出文本分析 F 与首个错误位置，因此该信号可直接指导修订，而不只是给候选排序。

SDV 将这一验证器与事件触发式停止相结合。犹豫关键词只定义稀疏探测时点；在这些时点，solver 通过完成度提示比较 log p(Yes) 与 log p(No)，关键词本身并不等于“已经完成”。当对数概率差为正时停止生成。随后 FlexiVe 接受该轨迹，或给出反馈以启动下一轮 solve–detect。

title: Method
方法
html:
FlexiVe-14B is initialized from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B and trained with GRPO on BIG-Bench Mistake. The reported split contains 1,526 training and 170 test samples. The target is the first error index or −1 for a correct trace. The reward combines exact index correctness with a length penalty, with λ = 0.1, and training activates the Fast Thinking/NoThinking template.

At inference, the paper’s preferred Flex setting uses k = 8 and agreement threshold τ = 0.8. Eight fast outcomes are collected over the whole trace; if consensus is below threshold, the system performs max(1, ceil(k/8)) slow runs. SDV begins with a step-by-step solver trace, segments it using predefined hesitation markers, and probes completion only at those events. If verification finds an error, its textual feedback and the current solution are included in the next attempt; the maximum number of attempts T controls sequential compute.

A reusable SDV record would preserve the problem and solver/model revisions; every generated prefix and trigger; Yes/No log-probabilities; stopping reason; fast outcomes and agreement; escalation decision; slow verification rationale; predicted error index; diagnostic feedback; revised traces; token/FLOP accounting; and final-answer correctness. No official code, model, SDV trajectory dataset, rejected-feedback log, or replay manifest is linked in the accepted metadata, so those release fields remain unknown.

FlexiVe-14B 由 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B 初始化，并在 BIG-Bench Mistake 上用 GRPO 训练。论文报告的划分为 1,526 条训练样本和 170 条测试样本。目标是预测首个错误位置；正确轨迹记为 −1。奖励由错误位置完全匹配与长度惩罚组成，λ = 0.1；训练时启用 Fast Thinking/NoThinking 模板。

推理时，论文推荐的 Flex 配置采用 k = 8、同意阈值 τ = 0.8。系统对完整轨迹收集 8 个快速结果；若一致率低于阈值，则执行 max(1, ceil(k/8)) 次慢速验证。SDV 先生成逐步 solver 轨迹，再用预定义犹豫标记切分，并只在这些事件点探测完成度。若验证发现错误，下一轮会同时接收当前解答与文本反馈；最大尝试次数 T 控制顺序计算量。

可复用的 SDV 记录应保留问题与 solver/model 版本、每个生成前缀和触发点、Yes/No 对数概率、停止原因、快速结果与一致率、升级决策、慢速验证 rationale、预测错误位置、诊断反馈、修订轨迹、token/FLOP 统计和最终答案正确性。已接受元数据未链接官方代码、模型、SDV 轨迹数据集、被拒反馈日志或回放清单，因此这些发布字段保持 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On ProcessBench, the paper reports 75.6 average F1 for FlexiVe and attributes the result to GRPO on 1,526 samples; comparisons with GenPRM report about 2.3× lower TFLOPS and 15× less training data. The ablation compares the same base model and 1.5K data across discriminative PRM, SFT, and GRPO settings, which is evidence about the tested training objective rather than proof that every verification rationale is correct.

For end-to-end SDV, the AIME 2024 table reports 83.3% accuracy at N = 16, versus 80.0% for solver-only majority voting and 66.7% for GenPRM-32B Best-of-N in that setup. Iterative results rise from 60.0% at two attempts to 73.3% at four attempts, and the paper reports correcting 25% of initially incorrect AIME 2024 solutions. These results support utility and compute allocation under the specified models and prompts. They do not establish item-level validity of completion probes, error indices, explanations, or revised traces, and they are not record-level data-quality evidence.

在 ProcessBench 上，论文报告 FlexiVe 的平均 F1 为 75.6，并将结果归因于在 1,526 条样本上的 GRPO；与 GenPRM 的比较报告约低 2.3 倍的 TFLOPS 和少 15 倍的训练数据。消融在同一基础模型和约 1.5K 数据上比较 discriminative PRM、SFT 与 GRPO，这能够说明所测训练目标的作用，但不能证明每条验证 rationale 都正确。

对端到端 SDV，AIME 2024 表格在 N = 16 时报告 83.3% 准确率；同一设置下，solver-only 多数投票为 80.0%，GenPRM-32B Best-of-N 为 66.7%。顺序修订从两次尝试的 60.0% 提升到四次尝试的 73.3%，论文还报告修正了 25% 的 AIME 2024 初始错误解答。这些结果支持特定模型与提示下的效用和计算分配，但不能证明每条完成度探测、错误位置、解释或修订轨迹在条目级都有效，也不是记录级数据质量证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper does not introduce iterative refinement, generative verification, or Best-of-N as general ideas. Its distinctive combination is: holistic first-error verification; one model spanning Fast, Slow, and consensus-gated Flex modes; RL targeted at the short fast mode; event-triggered completeness probing that reuses the solver’s own likelihoods; and diagnostic feedback that drives another attempt.

For rollout/search curation, the important shift is from a terminal candidate-and-score pair to a conditional trajectory of stop probes, verifier-budget decisions, localized feedback, and revisions. This exposes where computation was withheld or escalated and makes verification policy part of the trace object.

论文并未首创迭代修订、生成式验证或 Best-of-N。其差异化组合在于：对完整轨迹做首错定位；由同一模型覆盖 Fast、Slow 与一致率门控的 Flex 模式；专门针对短输出快速模式进行 RL；利用 solver 自身似然的事件触发式完成度探测；以及用诊断反馈驱动下一次尝试。

对 rollout/search 数据整理而言，关键变化是把“终局候选—分数”扩展为由停止探测、验证预算决策、局部反馈和修订组成的条件轨迹。这样既能记录何处节省或升级了计算，也把验证策略本身纳入轨迹对象。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The Detect module depends on a fixed hesitation lexicon and on calibration of the solver’s Yes/No completion probabilities. A missed trigger can preserve overthinking, while a false positive can truncate necessary reasoning. FlexiVe’s output localizes the first predicted error, not a formally proved error, and generative feedback can be persuasive but wrong.

The Flex risk bound assumes conditionally independent fast runs with per-run accuracy above one half; repeated samples from one model may be correlated. Fast consensus can therefore be confidently wrong, while slow escalation remains costly. Evaluation is concentrated on mathematical reasoning, ProcessBench, BIG-Bench Mistake, and AIME, so transfer to other domains is unknown.

The accepted artifact record does not verify released training instances, SDV trajectories, prompts, random seeds, model checkpoints, rejected outputs, decontamination, or a complete license matrix. Benchmark improvements measure a verifier/pipeline under selected protocols; they must not be promoted to proof of trace-label quality or a reusable data release.

Detect 模块依赖固定的犹豫词表，也依赖 solver 的 Yes/No 完成度概率是否校准。漏掉触发点会保留过度思考，假阳性则可能截断必要推理。FlexiVe 输出的是“预测的首个错误”，而不是经形式证明的错误；生成式反馈也可能听起来合理却实际错误。

Flex 的风险界假设快速运行在给定条件下相互独立，且单次准确率高于二分之一；同一模型的重复采样可能相关。因此快速共识仍可能自信地出错，而慢速升级仍然昂贵。评测集中于数学推理、ProcessBench、BIG-Bench Mistake 与 AIME，对其他领域的迁移能力保持 unknown。

已接受的 artifact 记录未核实已发布训练实例、SDV 轨迹、提示、随机种子、模型检查点、被拒输出、去污染流程或完整许可矩阵。Benchmark 提升只是在给定协议下对 verifier/pipeline 的评估，不能升级为轨迹标签质量证明或可复用数据发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This work belongs in the rollout/search/test-time-trace track because the decision record is a budgeted feedback loop: when to stop generating, how much verifier compute to spend, whether to accept a trace, and how feedback changes the next attempt. It is useful as a schema for collecting adaptive-verification trajectories and for comparing static Best-of-N with sequential correction.

For reuse, maintain separate fields for completion-probe outcome, verifier outcome, verifier rationale, refinement action, and final task correctness. That separation supports audits of premature stopping, correlated verifier consensus, feedback-induced regressions, and cost accounting. The paper supports test-time compute and verifier audit uses; it does not by itself establish an SFT or RL training corpus of SDV episodes.

该工作属于 rollout/search/test-time-trace 方向，因为其核心记录是一条受预算约束的反馈回路：何时停止生成、为 verifier 分配多少计算、是否接受当前轨迹，以及反馈如何改变下一次尝试。它可作为采集自适应验证轨迹的 schema，也可用于比较静态 Best-of-N 与顺序纠错。

复用时，应把完成度探测结果、verifier 结论、verifier rationale、修订动作和最终任务正确性分成独立字段。这样才能审计过早停止、相关的 verifier 共识、反馈引入的退化与成本统计。论文支持测试时计算和 verifier 审计用途，但没有据此建立 SDV episode 的 SFT 或 RL 训练语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Distinguish the 1,526-example BIG-Bench Mistake training split from unreleased SDV rollout trajectories.
  • Record every hesitation trigger and Yes/No log-probability; a keyword alone is not the completion predicate.
  • Audit fast-run correlation and the τ = 0.8 escalation decision before treating consensus as confidence.
  • Keep predicted error index, textual feedback, revised solution, and final correctness as separate fields.
  • Treat ProcessBench and AIME gains as pipeline evidence, not item-level trace-quality proof.

• 区分 1,526 条 BIG-Bench Mistake 训练划分与尚未发布的 SDV rollout 轨迹。
  • 记录每个犹豫词触发点及 Yes/No 对数概率；关键词本身不是完成判定。
  • 在把共识当作置信度前，审计快速采样之间的相关性与 τ = 0.8 的升级决策。
  • 将预测错误位置、文本反馈、修订解答和最终正确性保存为不同字段。
  • 把 ProcessBench 与 AIME 提升视为 pipeline 证据，而非条目级轨迹质量证明。
